description: This file defines APIs and includes necessary headers for the LED Manager plugin in a COSA Data Model Library, including function declarations for creating, initializing, and removing a backend manager, as well as macro definitions for object identifiers.

methods.name: BackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager with the given handle.

methods.name: BackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes the backend manager associated with the given handle.
